hero.title: Air that connects Latin America
hero.lead: GECAL is a peer scientific community: people and institutions working on air quality in Latin America who share methods, data and monitoring networks.

methods.title: Modelling and analysis
methods.body: Peers present and discuss how air quality is modelled, measured and analysed.

data.title: Monitoring and observation
data.body: Experience is exchanged on monitoring, low-cost sensors, emission inventories and satellite data.

networks.title: Monitoring networks
networks.body: People and institutions across the region are connected to collaborate between monitoring networks and modelling groups.

next.title: Coming up
next.empty: No meeting has been published yet. The next ones are announced in the WhatsApp group.

cta.title: Do you work on air quality in Latin America?
cta.body: The group brings together people and institutions from the region to exchange methods, data and experience.

community.title: Who we are
community.lead: People and institutions working on air quality in several countries. The directory shows only those who have authorised the publication of their professional profile.
community.progress: Published profiles: {published} of {registered} registered members. Each profile is published only with the person's authorisation.
community.empty: No profiles are published yet. They will appear as each member authorises theirs.
community.privacy: Only professional details are published. Emails and phone numbers are never shown.
community.bio_lang: Text written by the person, in {lang}.

uses.title: What the network uses
uses.lead: Most common models and tools among the {n} registered members.
uses.unit: Figure: members who use each tool.

activities.title: Activities
activities.lead: We meet online to present our work and talk about air quality. Any participant can present their monitoring network. What would you like to present?
activities.empty: No meetings have been published yet. Join the WhatsApp group and we will find out about the next one together.
activities.zones_note: Each time is for the exact date of the meeting; in some countries it changes with daylight saving time.
activities.channel: All recordings, on the GECAL YouTube channel

cta.title: What would you like to present?
cta.body: Write to us in the group and we will talk it over.

join.title: How to join
join.lead: The group is open to people and institutions working on air quality in Latin America.

step1.title: Join the WhatsApp group
step1.body: It is the channel where members talk and where the group's meetings are announced.

step2.title: Register in the directory
step2.body: The form asks for your area of work, the tools and models you use and, optionally, a short introduction and a photo.

who.title: Who can take part
who.body: People and institutions working on air quality in Latin America. Colleagues from other regions who collaborate with the network also take part.

privacy.title: What is published and what is not
privacy.shown_title: Published, if the person authorises it
shown: Name, institution, position, country and city
Areas of work, tools and models
The introduction and, if shared, the photo
hidden: Any data the person has not authorised
privacy.remove: Any member can ask for their profile to be removed at any time by writing to the group administrators.

map.aria: Map of Latin America with the network's countries highlighted and the number of registered members in each
map.legend: The number inside each country is its registered members. France appears in an inset, not to scale.
